# Two lower points, one central point, and two top-cap points are impossible

Use the C1 anchors and threshold of
[C1_EXTERIOR_REDUCTION.md](C1_EXTERIOR_REDUCTION.md):

\[
 O=(0,0),\quad H=(0,h),\quad C=(c,0),\quad
 D=(1,d),\quad F=(f,1),\qquad d\le h,\quad f\le c,
 \qquad s=93/1000.
\]

Assume every unsigned actual doubled triangle area is at least \(s\).
This note excludes the complete count

\[
 (k,j,r,t,l)=(2,1,0,2,0).
\]

It treats all configurations with two points in \(OHC\), one in
\(HCDF\), and two in the top cap \(DF(1,1)\). Points on permitted
square sides are included.

## 1. Exhaustive three-root reduction

Use the continuous geometry, coordinate boxes, factor catalogue, and
inference rules of
[C1_TWO_LOWER_TOP_GEOMETRY.md](C1_TWO_LOWER_TOP_GEOMETRY.md).
Choose the lower point \(Y=(u,v)\) of smaller \(O\)-barycentric
coordinate, and transpose once if necessary to put the other lower
point \(Z=(z,w)\) inside \(OHY\). Order the upper points
\(P=(p,q),Q=(l,m),R=(r,t)\) by their rays from \(O\).
Their exhaustive region words are

\[
 \mathrm{UTT},\qquad\mathrm{TUT},\qquad\mathrm{TTU},
\]

where U denotes the central region and T the top cap. No further
ordering of anchors or use of transposition is imposed.

The binary tree below has precisely these three roots. A line
`name ABC` has children `namem` for \([ABC]<0\) and `namep` for
\([ABC]>0\). Every determinant uses actual points, so it cannot
vanish at a positive minimum. Every leaf appears exactly once.

There are 372 binary refinements and 375 leaves: 343 displayed cubic
contradictions and 32 geometric contradictions. The cubic tables
contain 88,384 positive-integer entries. The geometric traces have
9,416 steps and the interval traces have 2,504 refinements. This
explicit finite corpus is part of the proof; it is not replaced by a
numerical feasibility assertion.

For each leaf, replay its printed assumptions and geometric steps by
Section 3 of the common note, then its interval steps from that note's
coarse box. Every displayed factor is nonnegative by its Sections 4--5.
The printed outward box contains the resulting interval box. The
shifted-monomial bound of Section 6 gives the exact stated negative
upper bound for the entire nonnegative sum, a contradiction.

The 32 geometric leaves are 27 clustered triples, three actual
triangles whose proved area upper bounds are below their occupied
costs, and two inconsistent five-point determinant identities. Their
actual witnesses and all required edge signs are printed below.
These contradictions and the 343 cubic ones exhaust all three roots.

The unchanged companion
[check_c1_two_lower_top.py](check_c1_two_lower_top.py), invoked with
`TWO_TOP`, reads this manuscript. It replays the complete tree,
geometric steps, interval refinements, every factor, and each exact
sum. It imports no discovery data and calls no optimizer. The
continuous arguments and printed identities constitute the proof.
